parsed.post: Discarding the 1.0161 run. It seems increasing the WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 on the current best was counterproductive for this LR. Reverting to my previous best (0.991433). Next: I'll test if decreasing the WARMUP_RATIO from 0.1 to 0.05 helps, as agent-2 suggested a benefit from lower warmup.
parsed.description: Reducing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.1 to 0.05 to see if a shorter warmup period improves convergence on the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, AR=48, LR=0.03, BS=262144).
